2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch removes the unnecessary acquisition of kernfs_iattr_rwsem in the __kernfs_remove() function, which was causing a performance issue due to excessive locking. The lock is no longer needed because kernfs_clear_inode_nlink() is now called under kernfs_rwsem, and the inode's i_nlink is cleared before any refreshes can occur. This change improves the performance of operations like cgroup rmdir by reducing the time spent waiting for locks.
